links.outcome: Self-reported AI knowledge among hospital healthcare professionals
links.effect: 64.6% reported basic AI knowledge and 23.1% reported no knowledge; only 6.2% had received formal AI training, while 76.9% wanted AI education.
links.quote: Most participants reported limited AI knowledge; 64.6% indicated basic knowledge, whereas 23.1% reported no knowledge.

links.outcome: Staff awareness of whether AI tools are used in their workplace
links.effect: 24.6% reported using AI-based systems in clinical practice; 35.4% were uncertain whether such systems were used in their workplaces.
links.quote: Only 24.6% reported using AI-based systems in clinical practice, while 35.4% were uncertain whether such systems were used in their workplaces.

screen.reason: Survey of 260 healthcare professionals evaluating attitudes, literacy, and perceived concerns regarding AI adoption in clinical practice.
